purpose: Decide the next route after retained-gate handoff probe and current-head sparse fused MMVQ placement probe.

retained_gate_handoff_probe.decision: Retained selected_experts/weights are already available. Passing only top-k/weights into build_expert_mix is not a new source-movement reduction. The missing piece is a retained gate/source context, but current evidence does not show an 80/80 cut path.

sparse_fused_mmvq_current_head_probe.constraints: strict MemoryMax=16000000000, MemorySwapMax=0, drop_caches, page cache counted
sparse_fused_mmvq_current_head_probe.decision: The default-off placement/proof skeleton works on current head, but this top48 profile is not a generalized SOTA route. Existing generalized sparse top64/top128/top256/top512 bounds remain closed.

generalized_sparse_pair.decision: closed_for_generalized_target; do not implement sparse-pair writeback/hot branch from current evidence

compact_batched_updown_alone.decision: up/down transfer alone is not sufficient for generalized 5 tok/s

simple_lowbit_sidecars.decision: q2ternary and simple codebook sidecars do not pass op-level correctness; exact sidecar has no compression benefit

external_iq2_iq2s.decision: vendor-loadable but France correctness failed; do not use for calibration/dev or held-out benchmark

remaining_viable_direction.interpretation: A representation with real 8x-ish gate and up/down compression has enough zero-overhead generalized margin, but no currently tested lowbit representation has passed correctness/top1.

next_allowed_work.allowed_next_step: offline or compare-only correctness gate for a stronger lowbit representation; it must prove fixed-text top1 and France semantic correctness before any runtime token-rate source patch.
next_allowed_work.fallback: If no correctness-verified representation appears, switch to external high-acceptance draft/verifier artifact search rather than local cache/source tuning.

decision.reason: Current retained-gate and sparse placement probes provide useful facts but do not satisfy the 80/80 generalized hard-bound gate. Existing lowbit attempts with concrete payloads failed correctness; only hypothetical lowbit bounds remain viable.
